review.description: Adopt S1-S3 from the existing complete-package/private-owner connection path. No product behavior was changed by this specification baseline.
review.implementation: Reviewed setup/plugin linking, portable versus registered browser packaging, and gateway owner consent. References name actual entry points; the existing endpoints and provider pin stay unchanged.
